parts.label: a
parts.ask: Show that \(2\tan\theta(8\cos\theta + 23\sin^2\theta) = 8\sin 2\theta(1 + \tan^2\theta)\) may be written as \(\sin 2\theta(A\cos^2\theta + B\cos\theta + C) = 0\), where \(A\), \(B\) and \(C\) are constants to be found. You must show all stages of your working.
parts.method: Use identities to write everything in \(\sin 2\theta\) and \(\cos\theta\)

steps.why: \(2\sin\theta\cos\theta = \sin 2\theta\). Don't divide by \(\sin 2\theta\): you'd lose roots.

parts.label: b
parts.ask: Hence solve, for \(360^\circ \leq x \leq 540^\circ\), \(2\tan x(8\cos x + 23\sin^2 x) = 8\sin 2x(1 + \tan^2 x)\), \(x \neq 450^\circ\).
parts.method: Solve each factor of part (a) separately

steps.why: The other solution, \(720^\circ - 130.7^\circ = 589.3^\circ\), is out of range.

check.answers: three angles: 360 and 540 from sin 2x = 0 (450 excluded), and 491 from cos x = -15/23; the assert checks the set
check.assert: Abs(360 + deg(acos(Rational(-15, 23))) - 491).evalf() < 0.5 and all((2*tan(rad(a))*(8*cos(rad(a)) + 23*sin(rad(a))**2) - 8*sin(rad(2*a))*(1 + tan(rad(a))**2)).evalf() < 1e-9 and (2*tan(rad(a))*(8*cos(rad(a)) + 23*sin(rad(a))**2) - 8*sin(rad(2*a))*(1 + tan(rad(a))**2)).evalf() > -1e-9 for a in (360, 540, 360 + deg(acos(Rational(-15, 23)))))
